note: Re-judged 2026-11-19 after D-4 (e700fb7392), the per-Child forward entries (ce5c276457), D-3 (072ef5bf1f) and the forward default (installUnmatched). Parent quote, RFC 4301 Section 4.4.1: "Every SPD SHOULD have a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it." Tested: "a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it". Gap: "Every SPD". Boundary producer: internal/component/ike/dataplane/vpp_policy.go::vppPolicyInterface. Other producers: installUnmatched and unmatchedPolicies (internal/component/ike/engine/unmatched.go), interfaceSPDCatchAll and installXFRMInterfaceEntries (unmatched_xfrm_interface.go), applyConfig and releaseSPD (apply.go), vppPolicyInterface (dataplane/vpp_policy.go), buildIPsecPolicies and defaultDataplaneSource (plugins/ospf/ipsec_install.go). Changed units: TestRFC4301FinalEntryIsUnderEveryZeSPDEntry dropped the eight IKE bypass entries from its write count because D-4 removed that entry kind (Ze's IKE is exempt per socket, bypassIKESocket); it still replays every write of the operator entry and the Child PROTECT entries and requires the catch-all beneath each state. TestRFC4301InboundClearPacketIsDiscardedByTheDefaultFinalEntry now fails on a refused operator install instead of ignoring it. Producer changes: installUnmatched may hand the forward half to the namespace forwarding default (ForwardDefaultInstaller) and removeUnmatched reports a failed removal; applyConfig still installs the catch-all first on the first apply. The gap is unchanged: vppBackend.CatchAllSupported still answers ErrNoNodeWideSPD, and the OSPF installer change adds removal reporting only, no final entry under its protocol 89 entries. Scoped evidence only; zero whole-requirement credit.
